name: Log
lead: A log or stem is a naturally occurring block found in trees or huge fungi , primarily used as a building block and to create planks , a versatile crafting ingredient. There are currently ten types of logs: oak , spruce , birch , jungle , acacia , dark oak , mangrove , cherry , pale oak and poplar ; and two types of stems: crimson and warped .
Logs and stems can be broken by hand, but using an axe is faster. Logs and stems drop themselves when broken with any tool.
